messages:
release-ops: FYI were initiating a short, targeted release freeze for EU production due to a KV cache tail-latency spike. This is a partial freeze — please pause non-critical canaries and low-priority rollouts in eu region for ~90m while we stabilize.

alex: On it. Which services need to stop their deploys?

release-ops: Scope: any release that routes to eu or pins eu-prod model variants. Out-of-scope: infra-only flips that do not touch cache shard placement. We'll publish the active canary list in 5m.

sarah: Do Dedicated customers get impacted? Should AMs be notified?

ops-oncall: Dedicated pools generally unaffected unless they hit shared KV clusters. CS/AMs: please use this template to notify customers if they have eu-only traffic.

release-ops: Mitigation steps in flight: 1) scale KV read replicas (in progress), 2) throttle background compaction jobs, 3) pause low-priority canaries (done for known list), 4) enact routing fallbacks to NA/APAC. Monitoring cadence: post metrics every 15m.

tim: If teams need to keep pushing, we recommend temporary routing overrides. Example command we used for Canary reroute:

```
# redirect 75% of traffic to NA for 60m
redwoodctl routing override --service payment-api --from-region eu --to-region na --percent 75 --duration 60m --reason "eu-kv-tail-spike"
```

maria: If a deploy is already mid-rollout, whats the exception flow?

release-ops: Exception process: open a thread tagged "release-exception" in #eng-releases, ping @release-ops and @ops-oncall. Exceptions considered for security patches, legal deadlines, or severe user-impact fixes. Triage turnaround ~15m.

sarah: Sending a pause to our CI jobs now. Will reroute critical canaries and update post-lift. :thumbsup:

release-ops: Lift criteria: 30m of normalized p99 latency and KV queue depth within normal bounds. Well post an explicit "freeze-lifted" message here. Next status update in 15m.

ops-oncall: Alert routing: if you see p99 spikes after lift, run diag script and tag @ops-oncall:

```
# KV diag snippet
python tools/kv_diag.py --cluster eu-main --since 15m
```

maria: Submitted exception request for a small hotfix (details in exception thread).

release-ops: Received and triaging now. Thanks for quick responses.
